response.title: which power station runs an rv air conditioner the longest
response.answer:
For running an RV air conditioner the longest, battery capacity (kWh) is the most important factor, followed by inverter output and the air conditioner's power consumption.

A typical RV rooftop air conditioner (13,500–15,000 BTU) draws around 1,200–1,800 watts while the compressor is running.

Here's approximately how long different battery capacities can power a 1,500W RV air conditioner:

Battery capacity

	

Estimated runtime

4 kWh

	

2–2.4 hours




6 kWh

	

3.2–3.6 hours




10 kWh

	

5.3–6 hours




15 kWh

	

8–9 hours




20 kWh

	

10.5–12 hours

These estimates assume continuous compressor operation and roughly 80–90% usable energy after inverter losses. Actual runtime can be longer when the compressor cycles off.

Here's approximately how long different battery capacities can power a 1,500W RV air conditioner:

| Battery capacity | Estimated runtime |
|---|---|
| 2 kWh | 1–1.2 hours |

| 6 kWh | 3.2–3.6 hours |
| 10 kWh | 5.3–6 hours |
| 15 kWh | 8–9 hours |
